title_voiceover: Now we're moving into the hemolytic anemia section. Hemolytic anemia occurs when red blood cells are destroyed faster than they can be produced. We classify these by mechanism. Immune-mediated hemolytic anemias involve antibodies or complement attacking the RBCs. Non-immune mediated hemolytic anemias result from abnormalities of the RBC membrane, enzyme deficiencies, or acquired conditions like paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria. Understanding these distinctions is essential for diagnosis and treatment.
